name: ERC20TokenBank
summary: ExchangeBetweenPools.doExchange(uint256) is permissionless and sends the selected ERC20TokenBank balance through Curve with min_dy = 0. The attacker distorted the USDC/USDT yPool, invoked doExchange to force the bank's 119,023.523157 USDC through the manipulated price for 47.391213 USDT, then reversed the distortion and captured the difference.
notes: ExchangeBetweenPoolsFactory created this direct 3,142-byte runtime with CREATE; the exploit calls doExchange(uint256) on it directly and its runtime hash is unchanged immediately before the exploit.

Gross victim depletion is the exact USDC balance decrease of from_bank 0x9ab872a34139015da07ee905529a8842a6142971, from 119,023.523157 USDC immediately before the transaction to zero afterward. The manipulated exchange returned only 47.391213 USDT to to_bank 0x21a3dbee594a3419d6037d6d8cee0b1e10bf345c. The attacker's exact 111,500.389841 USDC proceeds are smaller because Curve execution and the 120,000 USDC flash-loan fee are attacker costs; they do not reduce gross victim depletion.
